newsitem.title: CHINA: Earthquake hits China's Yunnan Province.
newsitem.headline: Earthquake hits China's Yunnan Province.

text.p: An earthquake measuring 5.6 on the open-ended Richter scale hit China's southwestern province of Yunnan on Thursday but there were no immediate reports of casualties or damage, an official said.

The official from the provincial seismological bureau said by telephone the earthquake struck at 5:59 p.m. (0959 GMT) between the cities of Jinghong and Jiangcheng, near the border with Laos and Burma.
"A 5.6 earthquake is not too dangerous. There could not be any deaths," the official said.
Officials of the State Seismological Bureau in Beijing said the earthquake measured 5.5 on the Richter scale. They also said there were no reports of casualties.
The official Xinhua news agency said the Yunnan provincial Seismological Bureau had sent a relief team to the area.
Experts say China is going through an active seismological period and there have been a number of tremors recently in the country's southwest.
